letterContent: I know I was stubborn and made you upset... I've been kicking myself all day.
Remember when we used to pass tiny folded notes across the table? I miss your smile so much.
Can we please call a truce? I'm ready to listen, whenever you're ready to talk.

photos.caption: Back when you weren't mad at me 🥺
I promise to make you smile again ✨

scratchCard.title: ✦ SECRET PEACE OFFERING ✦
scratchCard.hiddenText: Redeemable: 1x Midnight Ice Cream Run + Your Favorite Boba 🧋

runawayQuestion.question: Will you stop giving me the silent treatment?
runawayQuestion.successMessage: Yay! Text me right now, I'm waiting! 🥺❤
